# Variable `BUILD_VENDOR`

## Yocto Project Reference Manual

Specifies the vendor name to use when building for the build host. The default value is an empty string (“”).

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-BUILD_VENDOR
